description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called ContextUsageBar, which visually represents the usage percentage of context tokens with a colored bar indicator. It includes properties to customize appearance and methods to compute color and layout based on token usage statistics.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays a colored bar indicating the proportion of used tokens within a context window, with dynamic coloring based on usage percentage.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the normalized fraction (0 to 1) of used tokens relative to total context tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of used tokens as an integer, or nil if invalid.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides a string describing the context token usage percentage for accessibility features.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Constructs the visual bar component with filled and stroked rounded rectangles, colored based on usage percentage.
